comments.body:
**Resolution — complete solution written to solution.tex (Problem 10: Preconditioned CG for RKHS-Constrained CP Decomposition).**

This issue ("Proof: (untitled)") had no existing solution.tex; I wrote a full, self-contained solution. The problem matches the preamble macros exactly. It asks for a matrix-free preconditioned CG method for the SPD mode-k subproblem
  A vec(W) = (I_r ⊗ K) vec(B),   A = (Z⊗K)^T S S^T (Z⊗K) + λ(I_r⊗K),
avoiding all O(M) and O(N) work, with algorithm boxes for BOTH a direct symmetric solver and the PCG solver, plus complexity analysis.

**What I established (all numerically verified):**

1. Kronecker–vec identity (Lemma 1) + coordinate bookkeeping: observed entry has linear index ℓ_s = a_s + c_s·n (a_s = mode-k coord, c_s = other-modes column); Z̃ = Z[c,:] (q×r), K̃ = K[:,a] (n×q) are the only Z/K subsets needed.

2. Structured selection actions (Lemmas 2–3):
   - S^T(Z⊗K)vec(W) has entries y_s = (KW)[a_s,:]·Z[c_s,:];
   - (Z⊗K)^T S y = K̃ diag(y) Z̃.
   ⇒ compressed matrix A = G̃^T G̃ + λ(I_r⊗K), G̃[s,:] = Z[c_s,:]⊗K[a_s,:] (Lemma 4); A ≻ 0 for K≻0, λ>0 (PSD case handled in Remark 1 via range consistency).

3. Matrix-free matvec (Prop 5): V=KW; y_s=V[a_s,:]·Z̃[s,:]; H=K̃(diag(y)Z̃); return H+λV. Cost **O(n²r + nqr)**, no M/N.

4. Preconditioner P = λ(I_r⊗K): one Cholesky of K (O(n³)), then O(n²r) per apply. Spectral fact (Prop 6): P^{-1}A = I + (1/λ)(I_r⊗K^{-1})G̃^T G̃ has ALL eigenvalues ≥ 1 and ≤ min(q,nr) of them > 1 ⇒ PCG terminates in ≤ q+1 iters (exact arithmetic).

5. Complexity (Thm 9): PCG O(n³ + t·nr(n+q)), t ≤ q+1; direct O((nr)³ + q(nr)²). Both free of O(M),O(N). Two algorithm boxes provided (Alg 1 direct, Alg 2 PCG) with Input/Output and pseudocode; correctness/termination/complexity theorems (Thms 7–9).

**Numerical verification:** Kron–vec & both selection identities err ~1e-15; optimized matvec vs dense A err ~1e-13; compressed A vs dense A err ~1e-13; 30 random instances — direct & PCG both match dense solve to <1e-7 rel err; 40 random instances — P^{-1}A eigenvalues all ≥1 and #{>1} ≤ min(q,nr) (confirms finite-termination bound; the stated bound is exact-arithmetic, minor observed iteration overruns are standard finite-precision loss-of-conjugacy and noted as such).

LaTeX: all environments balanced, all \\ref/\\eqref resolved; added amsthm/float/algorithm/algpseudocode to preamble. No pdflatex toolchain present, so compilation skipped; structural checks pass.

Marking resolved.
